label: Generate Proposal
description: Draft a client proposal with the proposal-generator skill and save it to Google Docs.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.label: Client / project brief
inputs.placeholder: Who the client is, what they need, budget/timeline if known...

label: Upwork Proposal
description: Turn a pasted Upwork job post into a ready-to-send proposal (upwork-proposal-generator skill).

label: Quick Website Audit
description: Quick-mode audit of a prospect site (website-audit-system): top findings + outreach hook email.
prompt_template:
Use the website-audit-system skill (.claude/skills/website-audit-system/SKILL.md) in QUICK mode to audit this website: {url}

Follow the skill's quick-mode workflow (homepage-level analysis, 3-5 findings, hook email). Run fully autonomously - do not ask questions. If the skill saves a Google Doc, end your final message with the Doc link on its own line; otherwise output the findings and the outreach email in full.

label: Discovery Call Prep
description: 2-minute prep brief on a prospect: company snapshot, likely pains, positioning angles, sharp questions.

inputs.name: prospect
inputs.label: Prospect (company name and/or website)
inputs.placeholder: Acme Co - https://acme.com - any context you have (industry, who you're meeting)...

label: Claude Advisor
description: Research-backed answer to any question about Claude (surfaces, models, Claude Code, ecosystem, plans).

inputs.name: question
inputs.label: Your question about Claude
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Which Claude should I use for X? Opus vs Sonnet? Best Claude Code plugins?...

label: Lead Generator
description: Resolve company socials + founder identity for the next unresolved rows on the Main leads sheet (website-first).
prompt_template:
Use the lead-generator skill (.claude/skills/lead-generator/SKILL.md) to resolve the next {count} unresolved rows on the consolidated Main leads sheet, running its website-first pipeline end to end. Auto-write only the trusted website-sourced fields plus company socials, exactly as the skill does - never auto-write search-sourced founder fields. Do NOT block on interactive confirmation: instead of the one-by-one review, output the full needs_review queue in your final message so it can be confirmed later. Run fully autonomously - do not ask questions. This needs a live gws token; if Sheets access fails, say so plainly and stop. Summarize what was written and list the review queue.

ROWS TO RESOLVE: {count}

label: Post Creator
description: Turn a Weekly Posting Schedule row into a finished LinkedIn/Instagram post + image prompts, saved to a Google Doc.

inputs.name: row
inputs.label: Which schedule row (topic or row description)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. the next unprocessed row, or a specific topic from the Weekly Posting Schedule...

label: Research
description: Multi-engine research (Exa/Tavily/Serper/Jina) on any topic; medium by default, deep on request, cited.

inputs.name: query
inputs.label: What to research
inputs.placeholder: A topic, a person/company to profile, or a scientific question...
